question: In a certain code language, ‘YORK’ is coded as ‘0834’ and ‘KRAY’ is coded as ‘3458’. What is the code for ‘A’ in the given code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] 

The logic followed here is:

‘YORK’ is coded as ‘0834’ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/676528eeb5ea5c3721f166df5a76a53dbb038210e12d553cc0e3666ba4ab6e37.png] 

‘KRAY’ is coded as ‘3458’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/423597405f47d732eccec7dd1b201894318b375fc84a83d0fa822655f6463e12.png] 

So, '**5**' is the code for ‘A’ in the given code language.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
